tourFunnelDefinition: Confirmation uses an explicit fact. Both feedback received counts elapsed confirmed journeys with responses from the chef and current manager; it does not establish completion. Only a verified final outcome recorded by Local Cooks counts as completion or absence. New applications carry their tour source whichever apply route the chef uses, including those awaiting an outcome review. Application conversion requires current verified completion. Existing applications receive no automatic tour credit. An unverified closure is never visitor absence.
tourFunnelRecoveryDefinition: Recovery is a later completed kitchen tour after recorded absence, disruption, expiry, decline or cancellation. Each affected journey counts once. Elapsed time identifies missing records only; it never proves that a visit happened or that someone was absent.
tourFunnelBookingDefinition: Booked means a current confirmed or completed chef booking in the attributed tour’s kitchen, created after the application’s recorded approval and normal booking eligibility. Approval times for individual bookings are not recorded, so bookings created earlier are excluded.
